title: Esther Agrees to Help

questions.question: What did Mordecai do when he learned of the decree?
options: Tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and ashes
questions.correctAnswer: Tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and ashes
questions.explanation: Esther 4:1 (ESV): "...Mordecai tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and ashes..."

questions.question: Where was no one in sackcloth allowed to enter?
questions.explanation: Esther 4:2 (ESV): "...for no one might enter the king's gate clothed with sackcloth."

questions.question: What did Esther send to Mordecai initially?
questions.explanation: Esther 4:4 (ESV): "...She sent clothes to clothe Mordecai and to take off his sackcloth..."

questions.question: Who was the eunuch Esther sent to speak to Mordecai?
questions.explanation: Esther 4:5 (ESV): "Then Esther called for Hathach, one of the king's eunuchs..."

questions.question: What did Mordecai give Hathach to show Esther?
options: A copy of the written decree
questions.correctAnswer: A copy of the written decree
questions.explanation: Esther 4:8 (ESV): "He also gave him a copy of the written decree..."

questions.question: What law did Esther fear regarding approaching the king?
options: If anyone goes to the king inside the inner court without being called, there is but one law—to be put to death
questions.correctAnswer: If anyone goes to the king inside the inner court without being called, there is but one law—to be put to death
questions.explanation: Esther 4:11 (ESV): "...if any man or woman goes to the king... without being called, there is but one law—to be put to death..."

questions.question: How long had it been since Esther was called to the king?
questions.explanation: Esther 4:11 (ESV): "...And I have not been called to come in to the king these thirty days."

questions.question: What was the exception to the death penalty for uninvited approach?
options: If the king holds out the golden scepter
questions.correctAnswer: If the king holds out the golden scepter
questions.explanation: Esther 4:11 (ESV): "...except the one to whom the king holds out the golden scepter so that he may live."

questions.question: What warning did Mordecai give Esther?
options: Do not think that you will escape in the king's palace any more than all the other Jews
questions.correctAnswer: Do not think that you will escape in the king's palace any more than all the other Jews
questions.explanation: Esther 4:13 (ESV): "...Do not think to yourself that in the king's palace you will escape any more than all the other Jews."

questions.question: What famous phrase did Mordecai use?
options: Who knows whether you have not come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
questions.correctAnswer: Who knows whether you have not come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
questions.explanation: Esther 4:14 (ESV): "...And who knows whether you have not come to the kingdom for such a time as this?"

questions.question: What did Esther ask the Jews in Susa to do?
options: Hold a fast on my behalf
questions.correctAnswer: Hold a fast on my behalf
questions.explanation: Esther 4:16 (ESV): "Go, gather all the Jews to be found in Susa, and hold a fast on my behalf..."

questions.question: Specifics of the fast Esther requested?
options: Do not eat or drink for three days, night or day
questions.correctAnswer: Do not eat or drink for three days, night or day
questions.explanation: Esther 4:16 (ESV): "...and do not eat or drink for three days, night or day..."

questions.question: What sentence did Esther effectively pass on herself with her resolution?
questions.explanation: Esther 4:16 (ESV): "...Then I will go to the king, though it is against the law, and if I perish, I perish."

questions.question: Who went with Hathach to speak to Esther?
questions.explanation: The text says "Hathach went out to Mordecai" and "Mordecai told him". It was a messenger service.

questions.question: Where was Mordecai when he spoke to Hathach?
options: In the open square of the city in front of the king's gate
questions.correctAnswer: In the open square of the city in front of the king's gate
questions.explanation: Esther 4:6 (ESV): "So Hathach went out to Mordecai in the open square of the city in front of the king's gate."

key_verse_text: For if you keep silent at this time, relief and deliverance will rise for the Jews from another place, but you and your father's house will perish. And who knows whether you have not come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
